lines: Woh ishq jo humse rooth gaya, ab uska haal batayen kya?
couplets.en: What can I say now of the love that turned away?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor wrath, what honest verse can I recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo humse rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love has turned away from me.

lines: Ek hijr jo humko laahiq hai, ta der use dohrayen kya?
couplets.en: How long must I go on telling of the separation that haunts me?

lines: Woh zahr jo dil mein utaar liya, phir uske naaz uthayen kya?
couplets.en: Must I still indulge the whims of the one whose poison I took to heart?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor wrath, what honest verse can I recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo humse rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love has turned away from me.

lines: Ek aag lagi tanhai ki, jo saare badan mein phail gayi.
couplets.en: A fire of solitude caught and spread through my whole body.

lines: Jab jism hi saara jalta ho, phir daaman-e-dil ko bachayen kya?
couplets.en: When the whole body burns, how can I spare even the hem of the heart?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor wrath, what honest verse can I recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo humse rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love has turned away from me.

lines: Hum naghma-sara kuchh ghazlon ke, hum suratgar kuchh khwabon ke.
couplets.en: I sing a few ghazals and give shape to a few dreams.

lines: Be-jazba-e-shauq sunayen kya, koi khwab na ho to batayen kya?
couplets.en: What can I sing without longing, what can I tell without a dream?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor wrath, what honest verse can I recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo humse rooth gaya, ab uska haal batayen kya?
couplets.en: What can I say now of the love that turned away?
